description: Enhanced edge coverage for load_project_manifest: a project with zero modules, three modules declared out of alphabetical order (verifying ascending-name sorting), a module with parameters but no files block (empty dir/repo with key-sorted params), and a module with a files block declaring only a directory (empty repo).

input.manifest:
name: zeta-proj
modules:
    zeta:
        files:
            dir: z-dir
            repo: github.com/acme/zeta
    alpha:
        files:
            dir: a-dir
            repo: github.com/acme/alpha
    mid:
        files:
            dir: m-dir
            repo: github.com/acme/mid

cases.expected_output:
name=zeta-proj
module_count=3
module=alpha dir=a-dir repo=github.com/acme/alpha params=
module=mid dir=m-dir repo=github.com/acme/mid params=
module=zeta dir=z-dir repo=github.com/acme/zeta params=

input.manifest:
name: noFiles
modules:
    solo:
        parameters:
            zKey: 1
            aKey: 2

cases.expected_output:
name=noFiles
module_count=1
module=solo dir= repo= params=aKey=2,zKey=1

input.manifest:
name: partialFiles
modules:
    web:
        files:
            dir: web-dir

cases.expected_output:
name=partialFiles
module_count=1
module=web dir=web-dir repo= params=
